elements.description: How two or three sets overlap, as circles sized by the sets with each region's count on a chip, and a table view.

properties.name: sets
properties.description: The field naming the sets a row is about – one set, or the two or three it overlaps; by default "sets"

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size field: a set's size, or all that a pair or triple shares; by default "size"

properties.name: vennLabels
properties.description: The Venn diagram's own words, merged over defaultVennLabels

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the chart's name

properties.name: description
properties.description: One line under the heading

properties.name: data
properties.description: The rows to draw

properties.name: highlight
properties.description: What to emphasise: an index, a label, a list of them, "max", "min", "first", "last", "none", or a test

properties.name: format
properties.description: How values are written: "number", "integer", "percent", "compact", "currency", Intl options, or a function

properties.name: unit
properties.description: The unit after each value: "%", "ms", " runs"

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

properties.name: height
properties.description: The plot's height in px; by default the chart's own for its width

properties.name: still
properties.description: Draws everything at once: no entrance and no transitions

properties.name: easing
properties.description: How marks move: "spring", "easeOut", "easeInOut" or "linear"

properties.name: duration
properties.description: How long a move takes, in ms; by default the chart's own

properties.name: hideLabels
properties.description: Leaves the values off the marks

properties.name: hideTooltip
properties.description: No tooltip on hover or focus

properties.name: bare
properties.description: No card: just the plot, for a chart inside another component

properties.name: view
properties.description: The chart or the same numbers as a table. Changed by the Table button unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The words it shows and says, merged over defaultChartLabels

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: The Table button was pressed ({ view }: ChartViewChange); cancelable – prevented, `view` stays as it was

events.name: tc-mark-hover
events.description: The pointer or keyboard moved to a region, or off them ({ event }: ChartMarkHover)

events.name: tc-mark-click
events.description: A region was clicked, or picked with Enter or Space ({ event }: ChartMarkClick)

methods.name: linkActive
methods.description:
Shows the mark with this event key (or none) as active, as an echo of another chart – drawn, but with no tooltip,
announcement or event – for charts that move together (tc-small-multiples). A mark the chart's own pointer or
keyboard is on wins

functions.name: lensArea
functions.signature: lensArea(r1: number, r2: number, d: number): number
functions.description: The area two circles share, radii r1 and r2 with centres d apart

functions.name: distanceFor
functions.signature: distanceFor(r1: number, r2: number, overlap: number): number
functions.description: How far apart two circles' centres are for them to share `overlap`: bisection, as the lens shrinks with distance

functions.name: vennLayout
functions.signature: vennLayout(sizes: readonly number[], pair: (a: number, b: number) => number): { x: number; y: number; r: number }[]
functions.description:
Circles for up to three sets, in data units (area = size): the first two side by side, the third placed from its
distances to both, or at the nearest point it can go when they can't both be met

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the chart's name

props.name: view
props.description: The chart or the table – controlled when given

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view on mount when `view` isn't controlled

props.name: onMarkHover
props.description: The pointer or keyboard moved to a mark (null: off them)

props.name: onMarkClick
props.description: A mark was clicked, or picked with Enter or Space

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
